divergence: What if Ram Setu remained a continuous dry, passable land connection between India and Sri Lanka, supporting coastal ecology and cultural exchange?

branches.title: First Footpaths Across Sands
branches.summary: A continuous supratidal ridge lets coastal foragers move seasonally between India and Sri Lanka without boats. Shared camps, shell middens, and mangrove foods create one connected shoreline culture across the present strait.
branches.scene: At dawn, families carry woven baskets of oysters along a white limestone footpath flanked by mirror-still lagoons.

changes.assumption: Hypothetical condition: Holocene sea level, limestone shoals, and sand accretion maintain a continuous supratidal connection between Pamban Island and Mannar Island, with some marshy segments.
changes.uncertainty: Illustrative mask only, not reconstructed terrain; exact width, elevation, storm breaches, and persistence through sea-level pulses remain uncertain.

branches.title: Causeway Shrines Blend Motifs
branches.summary: Artists, masons, and pilgrims moving on foot carry pigments, carved motifs, and stories between the two coasts. Rest shrines along the ridge combine Indian and Sri Lankan lotus, conch, bird, and wave patterns into a distinctive shared coastal art.
branches.scene: Painters on bamboo scaffolds add turquoise waves and pink lotuses to a shrine wall as walkers pass below with lamps.

changes.assumption: Hypothetical condition: The emergent ridge is stable and wide enough in places for footpaths, rest shelters, rainwater storage, and small shrine platforms.
changes.uncertainty: Illustrative mask only; local foundation conditions, water supply, erosion, and the exact placement of structures remain uncertain.

branches.title: Pearl Lagoons Shared Calendar
branches.summary: The land connection shelters shallow lagoons where pearl oysters, chank shells, seagrass, and fish nurseries concentrate along both approaches. Divers and shore observers develop a shared seasonal calendar for reading tides, spawning cycles, and sustainable harvest times.
branches.scene: Divers surface beside the causeway holding pearl oysters toward elders who mark the season on knotted palm cords.

changes.assumption: Hypothetical condition: The ridge remains emergent and walkable while enclosing sheltered, shallow lagoon and seagrass habitats along parts of its margins.
changes.uncertainty: Illustrative mask only; lagoon depth, salinity, openings, sediment movement, and habitat distribution are not physically simulated.
